vocabulary_concerns: The three Boolean inputs can represent an inclusive minimum or a conjunction, but they cannot identify unspecified additional requirements. A necessary minimum alone does not define the requested licensing-trigger predicate.

The business input compresses case-dependent classification and the qualified phrase “should not in the ordinary course”. The vocabulary cannot separately express ordinary-course treatment, exceptions or regulatory intent.

The hong_kong input refers to “That business”, creating a potential dependency on business. The supplied vocabulary does not specify whether hong_kong must be false or remain unknown when business is false; no truth value or independence assumption should be invented.
The regulated input absorbs applicable carve-outs. Their legal boundaries and the incorporated authority cannot be independently tested within this vocabulary.
